titulo_es: Dominar la comunicación y la oratoria
estandares: Planeo, expreso y presento metas e ideas futuras con estructuras cohesionadas y lenguaje académico apropiado. Resumo y reporto información de manera efectiva.
competencias: Usar los tiempos futuros para proyectar planes; producir textos cohesionados con conectores; resumir con estilo indirecto; desarrollar oratoria persuasiva y organizar el tiempo de trabajo.
componentes: Pensamiento crítico, comunicación, colaboración y creatividad.

proyecto.descripcion_es: Cada estudiante prepara un discurso de cuatro a seis minutos en primera persona desde la perspectiva de un personaje literario o histórico: una decisión tomada, cómo afectó su futuro y qué cree que ocurrirá después, usando tiempos futuros, conectores y lenguaje persuasivo.
proyecto.descripcion_en: Each student prepares a four to six minute first-person speech from the perspective of a literary or historical character: a decision made, how it affected their future and what they believe will happen next, using future tenses, connectors and persuasive language.

lecciones.content_es:
Las cinco formas

  • will + base: predicción por opinión, decisión del momento, promesa.
  • be going to: intención decidida o predicción con evidencia.
  • Presente continuo: cita ya acordada.
  • will be + -ing: acción en curso en un momento futuro.
  • will have + participio: acción terminada antes de una fecha futura.

Aplicadas a un proyecto de vida

Next year I am starting university (ya está definido). I am going to study engineering (intención). By 2032 I will have graduated (terminado antes de esa fecha). In ten years I will be working in renewable energy (en curso entonces). I think it will be challenging (opinión).

La regla que no cambia

Después de when, before, after, as soon as, until, by the time se usa el presente: When I finish school, I'll travel.
lecciones.content_en:
The five forms

  • will + base: prediction from opinion, on-the-spot decision, promise.
  • be going to: a decided intention or a prediction with evidence.
  • Present continuous: an arranged appointment.
  • will be + -ing: an action in progress at a future moment.
  • will have + participle: an action finished before a future date.

Applied to a life project

Next year I am starting university (already set). I am going to study engineering (intention). By 2032 I will have graduated (finished before that date). In ten years I will be working in renewable energy (in progress then). I think it will be challenging (opinion).

The rule that never changes

After when, before, after, as soon as, until, by the time use the present: When I finish school, I'll travel.

lecciones.content_es:
Qué es la cohesión

Es lo que hace que un texto se lea como una unidad y no como frases sueltas. Se logra con conectores, pronombres de referencia y repetición controlada.

Conectores por función

  • Adición: moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides
  • Contraste: however, nevertheless, on the contrary, conversely
  • Causa y efecto: therefore, consequently, thus, as a result, hence
  • Ejemplo: for instance, namely, in particular
  • Énfasis: indeed, in fact, above all
  • Conclusión: in short, to sum up, overall, ultimately

Otros recursos de cohesión

  • Pronombres de referencia: this, that, these, such: This approach solved the issue.
  • Sinónimos para no repetir: the study → the research → the findings.
  • Elipsis: Some prefer speaking; others, writing.

Puntuación

Los conectores adverbiales (however, therefore) van al inicio con coma, o entre punto y coma y coma: …; however, …
lecciones.content_en:
What cohesion is

It is what makes a text read as one unit instead of loose sentences. It is achieved with connectors, reference pronouns and controlled repetition.

Connectors by function

  • Addition: moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides
  • Contrast: however, nevertheless, on the contrary, conversely
  • Cause and effect: therefore, consequently, thus, as a result, hence
  • Example: for instance, namely, in particular
  • Emphasis: indeed, in fact, above all
  • Conclusion: in short, to sum up, overall, ultimately

Other cohesion devices

  • Reference pronouns: this, that, these, such: This approach solved the issue.
  • Synonyms to avoid repetition: the study → the research → the findings.
  • Ellipsis: Some prefer speaking; others, writing.

Punctuation

Adverbial connectors (however, therefore) open with a comma, or sit between a semicolon and a comma: …; however, …

lecciones.t: Estilo indirecto para resumir y reportar
lecciones.t_en: Reported speech for summarizing and reporting
lecciones.content_es:
Reportar sin repetir

Al resumir una intervención no se copia lo dicho: se reformula con el verbo introductorio adecuado y el retroceso temporal.

El retroceso

presente → pasado · pasado y presente perfecto → pasado perfecto · will → would · can → could · must → had to.

Verbos introductorios con matiz

  • state, explain, point out: neutral e informativo
  • claim, allege: afirmación sin prueba
  • admit, deny: reconocer o negar
  • suggest, recommend: proponer (con gerundio o that)
  • warn, remind, promise, refuse: con to + infinitivo

Patrones

  • He admitted making a mistake. (gerundio)
  • She refused to comment. (to + infinitivo)
  • They reminded us to submit the form. (persona + to)
  • He explained that the delay was unavoidable. (that + oración)

Ojo

Si lo reportado sigue siendo verdad, el retroceso es opcional: She said the deadline is Friday.
lecciones.content_en:
Reporting without repeating

When summarizing a contribution you do not copy the words: you rephrase with the right reporting verb and the tense backshift.

The backshift

present → past · past and present perfect → past perfect · will → would · can → could · must → had to.

Reporting verbs with nuance

  • state, explain, point out: neutral and informative
  • claim, allege: an assertion without proof
  • admit, deny: to acknowledge or reject
  • suggest, recommend: to propose (with a gerund or that)
  • warn, remind, promise, refuse: with to + infinitive

Patterns

  • He admitted making a mistake. (gerund)
  • She refused to comment. (to + infinitive)
  • They reminded us to submit the form. (person + to)
  • He explained that the delay was unavoidable. (that + clause)

Careful

If what is reported is still true, the backshift is optional: She said the deadline is Friday.

lecciones.t_en: Phrases for presentations and public speaking
lecciones.content_es:
Abrir

Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. · Today I'd like to talk about… · My presentation is divided into three parts. · By the end, you will understand…

Avanzar

Let's start with… · Moving on to my second point… · This brings me to… · As you can see in this slide… · Let me give you an example.

Enfatizar

I'd like to stress that… · The key point here is… · What really matters is… · Let me repeat that.

Cerrar

To sum up… · In conclusion… · Let me leave you with one idea. · Thank you for your attention. Are there any questions?

Manejar preguntas

That's a great question. · If I understood correctly, you're asking… · I'm afraid I don't have that data with me, but I can follow up.

Consejo

Marcar la estructura en voz alta (first, second, finally) es lo que más ayuda al oyente a seguir el hilo.
lecciones.content_en:
Opening

Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. · Today I'd like to talk about… · My presentation is divided into three parts. · By the end, you will understand…

Moving forward

Let's start with… · Moving on to my second point… · This brings me to… · As you can see in this slide… · Let me give you an example.

Emphasizing

I'd like to stress that… · The key point here is… · What really matters is… · Let me repeat that.

Closing

To sum up… · In conclusion… · Let me leave you with one idea. · Thank you for your attention. Are there any questions?

Handling questions

That's a great question. · If I understood correctly, you're asking… · I'm afraid I don't have that data with me, but I can follow up.

Advice

Signposting the structure out loud (first, second, finally) is what most helps the listener follow you.

lecciones.content_es:
Recursos persuasivos

  • Pregunta retórica: Can we afford to wait?
  • Regla de tres: simpler, faster, fairer.
  • Contraste: Not a cost, but an investment.
  • Inclusión: uso de we y our para crear comunidad.
  • Dato concreto: Seven out of ten students say…
  • Llamado a la acción: Let's start today.

Registro académico

Se prefiere lo impersonal y lo matizado:

  • It can be argued that… · The evidence suggests… · This tends to indicate…
  • Matizadores: arguably, likely, to some extent, in most cases.
  • Se evitan contracciones, a lot of (mejor numerous o a considerable number of) y el lenguaje coloquial.

Equilibrio

Un buen discurso combina lo persuasivo con lo riguroso: convence con estructura y datos, no solo con emoción.
lecciones.content_en:
Persuasive devices

  • Rhetorical question: Can we afford to wait?
  • Rule of three: simpler, faster, fairer.
  • Contrast: Not a cost, but an investment.
  • Inclusion: using we and our to build community.
  • A concrete figure: Seven out of ten students say…
  • Call to action: Let's start today.

Academic register

The impersonal and the hedged are preferred:

  • It can be argued that… · The evidence suggests… · This tends to indicate…
  • Hedges: arguably, likely, to some extent, in most cases.
  • Contractions, a lot of (prefer numerous or a considerable number of) and colloquial language are avoided.

Balance

A good speech combines the persuasive with the rigorous: it convinces with structure and data, not only with emotion.

lecciones.content_es:
Rasgos y emociones

integrity (integridad), courage, guilt (culpa), shame, remorse (remordimiento), forgiveness (perdón), redemption, hypocrisy, compassion, prejudice (prejuicio), dignity.

Asuntos sociales y morales

social judgment, double standard (doble rasero), reputation, stigma, peer pressure, moral dilemma, consequence, responsibility, identity, personal values.

Discutir un dilema

  • Plantear: The dilemma here is whether…
  • Empatizar: From her perspective… · One could argue that she had no choice.
  • Juzgar con matiz: It was understandable, though not justifiable.
  • Concluir: Ultimately, the decision reveals…

Ojo

guilt es el sentimiento o la culpabilidad; fault es la responsabilidad por un error concreto: It's not my fault.
lecciones.content_en:
Traits and emotions

integrity, courage, guilt, shame, remorse, forgiveness, redemption, hypocrisy, compassion, prejudice, dignity.

Social and moral issues

social judgment, double standard, reputation, stigma, peer pressure, moral dilemma, consequence, responsibility, identity, personal values.

Discussing a dilemma

  • Framing: The dilemma here is whether…
  • Empathizing: From her perspective… · One could argue that she had no choice.
  • Judging with nuance: It was understandable, though not justifiable.
  • Concluding: Ultimately, the decision reveals…

Careful

guilt is the feeling or the state of being guilty; fault is responsibility for a specific mistake: It's not my fault.

lecciones.content_es:
Vocabulario clave

schedule (agenda o programar), deadline, priority, task, milestone (hito), workload (carga de trabajo), agenda, checklist, follow-up, procrastination.

Verbos y colocaciones

set priorities, meet a deadline, miss a deadline, allocate time, break a task down, delegate, postpone / put off, catch up on, keep track of, stick to a plan.

Expresiones de tiempo en el trabajo

ahead of schedule (adelantado), behind schedule (atrasado), on time (puntual), in time (con tiempo suficiente), at short notice (con poca antelación), round the clock (sin parar).

Ojo

on time es a la hora exacta; in time es con margen suficiente: The train arrived on time. · We got there in time to see the opening.
lecciones.content_en:
Key vocabulary

schedule, deadline, priority, task, milestone, workload, agenda, checklist, follow-up, procrastination.

Verbs and collocations

set priorities, meet a deadline, miss a deadline, allocate time, break a task down, delegate, postpone / put off, catch up on, keep track of, stick to a plan.

Time expressions at work

ahead of schedule, behind schedule, on time, in time, at short notice, round the clock.

Careful

on time means at the exact time; in time means with enough margin: The train arrived on time. · We got there in time to see the opening.

repaso.titulo: Repaso — Mastering Communication and Public Speaking
repaso.titulo_en: Review — Mastering Communication and Public Speaking
repaso.resumen_es:
Lo esencial del periodo

El cierre del ciclo integra tres competencias: proyectar con todos los tiempos futuros, cohesionar el discurso con conectores y reportar lo dicho con el verbo introductorio adecuado. Todo al servicio de una presentación clara y persuasiva.

Puntos gramaticales

  • will, going to, presente continuo, futuro continuo y futuro perfecto: cada uno con su situación.
  • Después de when, as soon as y by the time va el presente.
  • Conectores adverbiales con coma; punto y coma cuando unen dos oraciones.
  • Estilo indirecto: retroceso temporal y patrones admit + gerundio, refuse + to, remind + persona + to.

Vocabulario

Frases de presentación y manejo de preguntas, recursos persuasivos y matizadores académicos, carácter y dilemas morales, y gestión del tiempo con on time / in time.
repaso.resumen_en:
The core of the term

The end of the cycle integrates three competences: projecting with all the future tenses, cohering the discourse with connectors and reporting what was said with the right reporting verb. All in the service of a clear, persuasive presentation.

Grammar points

  • will, going to, present continuous, future continuous and future perfect: each with its situation.
  • After when, as soon as and by the time the present is used.
  • Adverbial connectors with a comma; a semicolon when they join two clauses.
  • Reported speech: tense backshift and the patterns admit + gerund, refuse + to, remind + person + to.

Vocabulary

Presentation phrases and question handling, persuasive devices and academic hedges, character and moral dilemmas, and time management with on time / in time.
